title: Human RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from 4 weeks post conception to adulthood (including ageing).

title: Chicken RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from day 10 post-conception to day 155 post-hatch in Gallus gallus.

title: Opossum RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from embryonic day 13.5 to adulthood in Monodelphis domestica.

title: Mouse RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from embryonic day 10.5 to adulthood in Mus musculus.

title: Rabbit RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from embryonic day 12 to adulthood in Oryctolagus cuniculus.

title: Rat RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
description: This dataset covers the development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary and testis) from embryonic day 11 to adulthood in Rattus norvegicus.

title: Human protein atlas - Normal tissue proteomics
description: Protein expression data from the Human Protein Atlas covering normal human tissues using mass spectrometry and immunohistochemistry approaches.

title: RNA-seq of human individual tissues and mixture of tissues
description: RNA sequencing of 95 human individuals representing 27 different tissues to study tissue-specific gene expression patterns and individual variation.

title: RNA-seq of mouse tissues
description: RNA sequencing analysis of multiple mouse tissues to characterize baseline gene expression patterns across different organ systems in Mus musculus.

title: Expression data from mouse tissues
description: Microarray gene expression profiling of various mouse tissues using Affymetrix arrays to establish baseline expression reference in Mus musculus.

title: Illumina Body Map 2.0
description: RNA-seq expression profiling of 16 human tissues using Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform providing comprehensive human tissue gene expression reference.

title: Human Protein Atlas - Cancer proteomics
description: Protein expression analysis in human cancer tissues from the Human Protein Atlas project using mass spectrometry and immunohistochemistry approaches.

title: RNA-seq of human brain regions
description: Transcriptome analysis of different human brain regions to understand regional gene expression differences and brain-specific expression patterns.

title: RNA-seq of human lung tissue
description: RNA sequencing analysis of human lung tissue samples for baseline gene expression characterization and pulmonary-specific expression patterns.

title: RNA-seq of zebrafish developmental stages
description: Time-course RNA sequencing analysis of zebrafish development from early embryonic to adult stages to study developmental gene expression programs.

title: RNA-seq of human thyroid tissue
description: RNA sequencing analysis of human thyroid tissue samples for baseline expression profiling and endocrine-specific gene expression patterns.

title: RNA-seq of human pancreatic islets
description: Transcriptome analysis of human pancreatic islet cells to study diabetes-related gene expression and beta-cell specific expression programs.

title: Expression data from human breast cancer cell lines
description: Microarray expression profiling of human breast cancer cell lines using Affymetrix arrays to characterize cancer-specific expression patterns.

title: RNA-seq of human keratinocytes
description: RNA sequencing analysis of primary human keratinocytes under different conditions to study skin-specific gene expression.

title: RNA-seq of human skin tissue
description: Transcriptome analysis of human skin tissue samples across different anatomical sites to characterize skin-specific expression patterns.

title: Expression data from human tissues
description: Microarray-based gene expression analysis across multiple human tissues and cell types using Affymetrix platform.

title: RNA-seq of human immune cell populations
description: RNA sequencing analysis of purified human immune cell populations to characterize cell-type specific expression and immune system gene expression patterns.

title: RNA-seq of human fetal tissues
description: Transcriptome analysis of human fetal tissues across different developmental stages to study prenatal gene expression programs.

title: RNA-seq of human liver tissue
description: RNA sequencing analysis of human liver tissue samples for baseline hepatic gene expression and liver-specific expression patterns.
